tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_spectre_spectral_da: Spectre flings a dagger to draw a Shadow Path, dealing damage and slowing the movement speed of any enemies along the trail. Units hit by the dagger also trail a Shadow Path. While treading the path, Spectre moves faster and phases through otherwise impassable terrain.
Mercurial's dagger eclipses the physical plane in shadow, a state in which mortals cower, but spectres thrive.
There is a %dagger_grace_period% second grace period after leaving the path where no collision is preserved.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_spectre_haunt_Descr:
Creates a spectral nemesis to haunt all enemy Heroes.

Haunt illusions are uncontrollable, take extra damage, and deal less damage than Spectre herself. They ignore terrain.

The Reality sub-ability may be used to teleport to the illusion, destroying it.
tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_spectre_haunt_Lore: At the height of combat, Mercurial's physical manifestation shatters, and the shadowy pieces haunt those who still cling to life.
tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_spectre_haunt_scept:
The first time Spectre uses Reality on a Haunt illusion, enemies in a %fear_aoe% area around the target are Feared away from Spectre for %fear_duration%s and have their movement speed slowed by %fear_movespeed_slow%%%.

Reduces cooldown by %scepter_cooldown_reduction_tooltip%s.

tokens.npc_dota_hero_spectre_bio: Just as higher states of energy seek a lower level, the Spectre known as Mercurial is a being of intense and violent energy who finds herself irresistibly drawn to scenes of strife as they unfold in the physical world. While her normal spectral state transcends sensory limitations, each time she takes on a physical manifestation, she is stricken by a loss of self--though not of purpose. In the clash of combat, her identity shatters and reconfigures, and she begins to regain awareness. She grasps that she is Mercurial the Spectre--and that all of her Haunts are but shadows of the one true Spectre. Focus comes in the struggle for survival; her true mind reasserts itself; until in the final moments of victory or defeat, she transcends matter and is restored once more to her eternal form.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_spectre_hype: Spectre haunts her enemies wherever they may be. Able to destroy lone prey with ease, she spreads her presence throughout the battlefield to choose her target. Once she has gathered her strength, none can escape her terrible wrath.

The effect lessens with distance.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* The ability effects are applied as follows:
*# {{Symbol|Damage|Reflect}}
*#* Reflects all {{M|incoming damage}} ([[before reductions]]), with the reflected damage value ({{Code|RDmg}}) defined as:
*#** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|RDmg {{=}} IncomingDmg × {{ValueColor||{{#var:Dispersion type1 value1 shd}}|shd|x}} × {{#var:Dispersion value3}} OR {{ValueColor||{{#var:Dispersion value3 tal}}|tal|x}}}}
*#*** Damage taken by Spectre can only be affected by other offensive incoming damage manipulation sources applied on Spectre.
*#*** Hence the ability fully reflects overkill damage dealt to Spectre.
*#* {{Symbol|Damage|No-reflection}}
*#** Does not reflect {{M|HP Removal}} sources.
*# [[File:Dota2 Spectre Dispersion Visualized icon.png|84px]] Applies {{Code|RDmg}} to all enemy units within radius [[File:Dota2 Letter-f.png|21px|F]] with the following properties:
*#* The reflected damage is applied as the same damage type applied to Spectre from the damage source.
*#* Has the {{M|HP Removal}} flag, and does not proc {{M|on-damage effects}}.
*#* {{Symbol|a|Up}}
*#** The closer the proximity to Spectre, the greater the {{Code|RDmg}} applied to the enemy units.
*#*** Increases by {{calc|v1*100/({{#var:Dispersion value2}}-{{#var:Dispersion value1}}) round4|v1={{#var:Dispersion value3}}|%}} ({{Symbol|bonus t4l}} {{ValueColor||{{calc|v1*100/({{#var:Dispersion value2}}-{{#var:Dispersion value1}}) round4|v1={{#var:Dispersion value3 tal}}|%}}|25tal}}) per 100-distance toward the min radius.
*# {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
*#* Spectre receives the damage with a generic {{M|incoming damage|t=p}} reduction applied.
*#** Hence, if both Spectre and an enemy would die to the damage simultaneously, the enemy is always killed first.
*#* The generic incoming damage has the following properties, and is defined as:
*#** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|DamageReceived {{=}} IncomingDmg × {{ValueColor||{{#var:Dispersion type1 value2 shd}}|shd|x}} × ({{#var:Dispersion value4}} + {{ValueColor||{{Show|T|Spectre|v4l}}%|tal|x}})}}
*#*** Affects all [[damage types]].
*#*** Stacks additively with other generic incoming damage sources.
*#* Does not reduce damage of {{M|HP Removal}} sources.
<hr>
* {{cf|shdnotes}} Adds an active component to Dispersion that increases the damage reduction and damage reflection values upon cast.
** {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
*** Interrupts Spectre's {{M|channeling}} abilities upon cast.
*** Since {{M|break}} sources fully disables the ability, the active ability becomes non-functional and does nothing upon cast.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* {{Symbol|a|Sub}}
** This [[sub-ability]] is unlocked in the {{Spellslot|4|5}} upon learning either {{A|Spectre|Shadow Step}} or {{A|Spectre|Haunt}}, and always stays active.
** Cannot cast on {{M|untargetable}} illusions.

* Has the following targeting functionalities:
** {{Symbol|Target|Unit}}
*** When unit-targeted, Spectre exchanges place with the {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} unit-targeted [[illusion]].
** {{Symbol|Target|Ground}}
*** When ground-targeted, Spectre exchanges place with the nearest {{Symbol|Target|Ground}} ground-targeted illusion.

* The ability effects are applied as follows:
*# {{M|Invulnerability}}
*# {{M|Teleports}} Spectre to the targeted illusion upon cast.
*#* Does not {{M|disjoint}} incoming {{M|projectiles}}.
*#* Does not proc {{M|on-cast effects}}.
*#* Has the following travel speeds, whichever is faster:
*#*# {{hi|Spectre}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Haunt}} at {{#var:Reality value1}}-speed.
*#*# {{hi|Spectre}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Haunt}} in {{#var:Reality value2}} seconds.
*#* Hence, Spectre travels even faster when the distance between her and the {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} unit-targeted illusion are {{Code|≥ {{#expr:{{#var:Reality value1}}*{{#var:Reality value2}}}}-distance}}.
*# {{M|Instant kills}} the {{A|Spectre|Shadow Step}}-based or {{A|Spectre|Haunt}}-based illusion.
*# {{cf|aghnotes}} Applies {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|spectre_haunt_fear}} to all affected enemy units within the radius centered around Spectre:
*#* {{M|Cannot act}}
*#* {{M|Caster-fear}}
*#* {{M|Disarm}}
*#* {{M|Muted}}
*#* {{M|Silence}}
*#* Affects the following units:
*#** {{M|Fogged}} units.
*#** {{M|Invisible}} units.
*#* Does not affect the following units:
*#** {{M|Hidden}} units.
*#** {{M|Invulnerable}} units.
<hr>
* {{cf|aghnotes}} Can be cast multiple times until {{A|Spectre|Haunt}} ends or all {{A|Spectre|Shadow Step}}-based illusions are killed.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_spectre
data.bio_loc: Just as higher states of energy seek a lower level, the Spectre known as Mercurial is a being of intense and violent energy who finds herself irresistibly drawn to scenes of strife as they unfold in the physical world. While her normal spectral state transcends sensory limitations, each time she takes on a physical manifestation, she is stricken by a loss of self--though not of purpose. In the clash of combat, her identity shatters and reconfigures, and she begins to regain awareness. She grasps that she is Mercurial the Spectre--and that all of her Haunts are but shadows of the one true Spectre. Focus comes in the struggle for survival; her true mind reasserts itself; until in the final moments of victory or defeat, she transcends matter and is restored once more to her eternal form.
data.hype_loc: Spectre haunts her enemies wherever they may be. Able to destroy lone prey with ease, she spreads her presence throughout the battlefield to choose her target. Once she has gathered her strength, none can escape her terrible wrath.
data.npe_desc_loc: Haunts her enemies and teleports to her target

abilities.name: spectre_spectral_dagger
abilities.desc_loc: Spectre flings a dagger to draw a Shadow Path, dealing damage and slowing the movement speed of any enemies along the trail. Units hit by the dagger also trail a Shadow Path. While treading the path, Spectre moves faster and phases through otherwise impassable terrain.
abilities.lore_loc: Mercurial's dagger eclipses the physical plane in shadow, a state in which mortals cower, but spectres thrive.
notes_loc: There is a %dagger_grace_period% second grace period after leaving the path where no collision is preserved.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

abilities.name: spectre_shadow_step
abilities.desc_loc:
Sends an uncontrollable illusion at a target that follows and attacks the target.

The Reality sub-ability may be used to teleport to the illusion, destroying it.
abilities.lore_loc: With great focus of will, Mercurial can sometimes limit the extent of her division.

abilities.name: spectre_dispersion
abilities.desc_loc: Spectre disperses part of the damage dealt to her, reflecting it to all nearby enemies. The effect lessens with distance.
abilities.lore_loc: A daunting task lies before enemies of Mercurial - killing a shadow with blade and magic.
notes_loc: The reflected damage is not dealt to Spectre.
Damage is reflected before reductions, and is returned as the same damage type.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
abilities.shard_loc: Dispersion can be activated to increase the amount absorbed and reflected by Dispersion by %activation_bonus_pct%%% of its base values for %activation_duration%s. Cooldown %activation_cooldown%. Manacost %activation_manacost%.

abilities.name: spectre_desolate
abilities.desc_loc: Spectre and her illusions deal bonus Pure damage if attacking an enemy that does not have any allied units within a %radius% radius around them.
abilities.lore_loc: Often times, warriors find themselves alone with a vision of Mercurial - the fated question is if it is the true Spectre.
notes_loc: Damage is dealt before Spectre's attack.
facets_loc: Spectre deals %bonus_damage_multiplier_tooltip%x damage with Desolate. Spectre's illusions no longer have Desolate.

abilities.name: spectre_haunt
abilities.desc_loc:
Creates a spectral nemesis to haunt all enemy Heroes.

Haunt illusions are uncontrollable, take extra damage, and deal less damage than Spectre herself. They ignore terrain.

The Reality sub-ability may be used to teleport to the illusion, destroying it.
abilities.lore_loc: At the height of combat, Mercurial's physical manifestation shatters, and the shadowy pieces haunt those who still cling to life.
abilities.scepter_loc:
The first time Spectre uses Reality on a Haunt illusion, enemies in a %fear_aoe% area around the target are Feared away from Spectre for %fear_duration%s and have their movement speed slowed by %fear_movespeed_slow%%%.

Reduces cooldown by %scepter_cooldown_reduction_tooltip%s.

officialDataset.interpretation: Official website declarations, retained in full; not an assertion of complete engine verification.
